description: Ready-to-use sample queries for HETVAYA Product AI Assistant

queries.title: Check Out-of-Stock Products
queries.curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8001/chat -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"message": "Which products are currently out of stock?"}'

payload.message: Which products are currently out of stock?

queries.title: FEFO Expiry Risk Assessment
queries.curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8001/chat -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"message": "Which products are at risk of expiry?"}'

payload.message: Which products are at risk of expiry?

queries.title: Stock Availability for Specific SKU
queries.curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8001/chat -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"message": "What is the available inventory for Aashirvaad Atta?"}'

payload.message: What is the available inventory for Aashirvaad Atta?

queries.title: Warehouse Sourcing with SKU Context
queries.curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8001/chat -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"message": "Which warehouse can supply this product?", "context": {"product_sku": "SKU-OIL-01"}}'

payload.message: Which warehouse can supply this product?

queries.title: Corridor Freight Cost Calculation
queries.curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8001/chat -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"message": "What is the estimated freight cost from Pune to D-Mart?"}'

payload.message: What is the estimated freight cost from Pune to D-Mart?

queries.title: Explain Distribution Allocation Justification
queries.curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8001/chat -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"message": "Why was this product allocated to this retailer?", "context": {"product_sku": "SKU-ATT-05", "retailer_id": "RET-GAN"}}'

payload.message: Why was this product allocated to this retailer?

queries.title: Multilingual Query in Hindi
queries.curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8001/chat -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"message": "Which products are out of stock?", "language": "hi"}'

payload.message: Which products are out of stock?
